---
name: Scoped language research
about: Investigate a concrete linguistic question for PERSON recognition
title: "[Research] "
---

## Question and motivation

Which assumption or observed failure does this question address?

## Scope and exclusions

Language tags, varieties, regions, scripts, domains, registers, entity types; known gaps.

## Sources and durable output

Publisher/source plan and expected `studies/` or `comparative/` paths. Link existing findings and record whether examples are synthetic, adapted or attested.

## Contrasts and falsifiable hypothesis

Positive example, hard negative, boundary contrast and a result that would challenge the hypothesis.

## Downstream decisions

Evidence, evaluation and implementation proposals with owners; links or explicit deferral reasons. No support claim from research alone.

## Completion

- [ ] Findings merged with source locators and scope.
- [ ] Original examples/translations, counterexamples and limitations checked.
- [ ] Reviewer identity, date and review scope recorded.
- [ ] Downstream handoffs linked or reviewed no-action reasons recorded.
- [ ] Schema and local-link validation passes.
